scope: Native personal observer selection and coarse belief admission
finding: EnemyDetected selected an observer with unit knowsAbout, which can reflect shared group knowledge. A leader without personal sight could displace a sampled native personal detector.

CortexKnowledge prioritised cached observers only after coarse leader getHideFrom range/shortlist admission. Missing or stale leader geometry could reject a contact before the personal detail pass could refine it.
implementation: Within the existing rotating <=12 sampled members, read native targetKnowledge and prefer freshest knownByUnit lastSeen/lastThreat. Preserve knownByGroup approximate fallback when no sampled personal witness exists. Native ignore policy vetoes publishing before cache/wake.
Build an <=8 target-keyed cache from already eligible retained observers. Coarse geometry uses that observer native getHideFrom before range admission; if unavailable, leader belief remains fallback.
Detailed targetKnowledge evaluation remains <=8 candidates by <=8 members, unchanged schemas/expiry. No reveal, exact live hostile transform, new handler, worker or world query.

validation.result: PASS full offline pipeline including HEMTT/FSM/SQF/config/docs/package; existing regression cases extended, no new test count
validation.provenance: Unsigned baseline plus intended runtime/test/guide edits and retained unrelated dirt. Engineering metadata added afterward. Not a clean signed release.
validation.limits: Source contracts and illustrative observer-selection model do not execute native targetKnowledge/getHideFrom, prove actual contact/wake/behaviour, locality or measured performance.

cost: Up to12 targetKnowledge reads on a real native event replace group-shared knowsAbout observer qualification; one group confidence read. Existing knowledge loop builds <=8 witness keys and may read <=8 additional leader fallback beliefs. No detailed-pass expansion; actual cost unmeasured.
material_remaining: Sampling can miss an out-of-window personal observer; group-only fallback is approximate awareness, not new visual proof.
Live wingman detection with leader in cover, mounted/air contacts, ignore policy, locality migration and performance remain unverified.
Movement/FSM/combined-arms/source parity and full production objective remain incomplete.
